paragraphs.text: Until the 1990s most offices offered instant coffee from a tin, and few employees thought about it. Today a machine that grinds beans is expected even in small companies, and job advertisements sometimes mention it.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The change has a cost. A good machine needs cleaning every day and a service twice a year; when neither happens, the coffee tastes worse than the instant it replaced.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Employers say the machine pays for itself. Staff who stay in the building for their break return to work sooner than those who walk to a café, and the kitchen becomes a place where teams meet by chance.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Not everyone agrees. Some managers see the queue at the machine as lost time, and a few companies have moved the machine away from the desks so that conversations there do not disturb others.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: Until the 1990s most offices offered instant coffee from a tin

explanation.en: The paragraph describes the shift from instant coffee to machines — a change, not a cost → ii.
explanation.kk: Абзац еритін кофеден кофемашинаға көшуді сипаттайды — бұл өзгеріс, баға емес → ii.
explanation.ru: Абзац описывает переход от растворимого кофе к кофемашинам — это изменение, а не цена → ii.

items.quote: A good machine needs cleaning every day and a service twice a year

explanation.en: Daily cleaning and two services a year are the price of better coffee → i.
explanation.kk: Күнде тазалау мен жылына екі рет қызмет көрсету — жақсы кофенің шығыны → i.
explanation.ru: Уборка каждый день и обслуживание дважды в год — это расходы на хороший кофе → i.

items.quote: Employers say the machine pays for itself.

explanation.en: Employers give arguments for the machine: shorter breaks, chance meetings → iii.
explanation.kk: Жұмыс берушілер машинаның пайдасын айтады: үзіліс қысқа, кездейсоқ кездесу → iii.
explanation.ru: Работодатели приводят доводы за машину: короче перерыв, случайные встречи → iii.

items.quote: a few companies have moved the machine away from the desks

explanation.en: Managers’ doubts and the practical answer of moving the machine → iv.
explanation.kk: Менеджерлердің күмәні және шешім — машинаны әрі қарай жылжыту → iv.
explanation.ru: Сомнения менеджеров и решение — перенести машину подальше → iv.
